body_plan: shelled biped (blue biped, red fin cheeks, tan shell carried on the back)
material: RIGID shell (the honest exception - the shell never deforms) + fleshy limbs/head; heavy for his size
mass_class: heavy (for his size) - his timing is the slowest in the cast
volume_rule: shell volume/shape invariant in every frame; body squash only in legs on foot-plant
rest_shape: canon cutout stance; shell rides as a separate lagging mass

idle.description: breathing in the exposed flesh (+/-1-2%), weight shifts foot-to-foot every few seconds (whole-body rock +/-1.5 deg, shell included as rigid mass), shell settles 2-3f AFTER the body stops (carried-weight follow-through); head look-arounds as intermittent secondary. His avatar/show form's eye-whites are his personal deviation (owner ruling) - kept.
idle.secondary_break: head look-around or shell knock-shiver every few loops

locomotion.cycle: slow anticipation (lean + shell pitch) -> deliberate steps with body pitch/roll -> foot-plant squash in the LEGS -> head bob counter-phase; his fastest move is still slower than every other cast member's normal (timing contrast is his identity)
locomotion.ground_contact: heavy foot plants; weight-dependent settle (BW send-out tremor rule)

anticipation: retract slightly + lean before effort; crouch is in the legs only
settle: whole-body rotational wobble on the feet (2 cycles, shell true) + shell lag 2-3f

secondary_chains.behaviour: rigid; lags body rotation/translation by 2-3f as a carried mass

signature_motions.name: Water Orb
signature_motions.note: both-hands orb gather: anticipation lean-back, orb forms, settle rock after release

signature_motions.name: shell-knock reaction
signature_motions.note: rock + rotational wobble, offended posture, shell true

signature_motions.name: droop drag
signature_motions.note: low head, slow drag steps (Thomas & Johnston's drag-feet, literally)

emotion_map.sad: low head, drag steps, rock nearly gone
emotion_map.scared: retract toward shell, tremble in limbs only

state_map.hurt: idle slows (BW weakened rule), favouring one foot
state_map.sleep: sits, shell as backrest, breath only

forbidden_motions: shell squash/stretch in ANY frame (breaks material honesty and the cast's contrast)
smear_drawing: none on the shell; limb smear allowed on fastest (for him) swings
sound_linked_motions: cry = chest swell + shell shiver beat

spring.note: rotation settle spring; springs OFF for shell shape

deform.note: uniform rigid-class transforms only (rotate/translate/sub-3% breath) - no silhouette warp
